# id: PG-gate-87-balance-stealth-fs
# covers: PG 195 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# variant: pg_formulas on (FormulaScaling), professions written as <prof>_fs
# gate: validation gate (RUN_ORDER.md): g1 skill 25 gear none, g2 skill 25 gear own50, g3 skill 90 gear none, g4 skill 25 gear none, same fixture and method as the matrix file
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: a fresh neutral observer per point (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGW<n>) spawned 100 m from Beaks,
#   who sneaks (detecttime: sneak on). Result = game seconds until seen
#   (timeout 180 s). The sneaker's skill/gear varies (stealth).
#   The observer is killed and moved away after every point.
# verify: seen=1 in most points (seen=0 everywhere: this observer never notices a sneaker, send the .out to
#   the PG agent); stealth: seconds_to_seen grows with Stealth; perception: it shrinks with Perception.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
pg_formulas on ~ formulaScaling=1 hooks=8/8
wake Avarek
pin Avarek ~ pinned
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 60 ~ moved=1
setstat Beaks stealth 30
give Beaks "Iron Hat" 1
equip Beaks "Iron Hat"
pg_info Beaks "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- g1: stealth 25, gear none ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 60 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGW1
pin PGW1 face Beaks ~ pinned
relation PGW1 0
setstat PGW1 perception 30
setstat Beaks stealth 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Beaks stealth ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks PGW1 dist 100 ~ moved=1
face PGW1 Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW1 Beaks ~ dist=(\d{1,2}|1[0-1]\d)\.\d observer_ko=0
speed 1 hold
stat Beaks stealth ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW1 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth_fs,25,0,none,g1,detect_sneaker,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW1 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW1
@until 30 teleport PGW1 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
# --- g2: stealth 25, gear own50 ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 60 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGW2
pin PGW2 face Beaks ~ pinned
relation PGW2 0
setstat PGW2 perception 30
setstat Beaks stealth 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Beaks "Iron Hat" stealth 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Beaks stealth ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks PGW2 dist 100 ~ moved=1
face PGW2 Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW2 Beaks ~ dist=(\d{1,2}|1[0-1]\d)\.\d observer_ko=0
speed 1 hold
stat Beaks stealth ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW2 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth_fs,25,50,own50,g2,detect_sneaker,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW2 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW2
@until 30 teleport PGW2 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
# --- g3: stealth 90, gear none ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 60 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)

pin PGW3 face Beaks ~ pinned

setstat PGW3 perception 30
setstat Beaks stealth 90

pg_statprobe read
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3

@until 30 teleport Beaks PGW3 dist 100 ~ moved=1
face PGW3 Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@echo READY
face PGW3 Beaks ~ dist=(\d{1,2}|1[0-1]\d)\.\d observer_ko=0
speed 1 hold
stat Beaks stealth ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW3 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth_fs,90,0,none,g3,detect_sneaker,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW3 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW3
@until 30 teleport PGW3 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
# --- g4: stealth 25, gear none ---
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 60 ~ moved=1
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 100 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)

pin PGW4 face Beaks ~ pinned

setstat Beaks stealth 25

face PGW4 Beaks

face PGW4 Beaks ~ dist=(\d{1,2}|1[0-1]\d)\.\d observer_ko=0
speed 1 hold
stat Beaks stealth ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T detecttime Beaks PGW4 timeout 180 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+ seconds_to_maybe=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,195,stealth_fs,25,0,none,g4,detect_sneaker,180,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
pin PGW4 off ~ unpinned
kill PGW4
@until 30 teleport PGW4 Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
stealth Beaks off
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 3 ~ moved=1
pg_formulas off
